newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI retains state bond oversubscriptions.
newsitem.headline: India RBI retains state bond oversubscriptions.

text.p: A 10-year bond issue by 25 state governments in India was heavily oversubscribed and the excess subscriptions will be fully retained, the central bank said.
Subscriptions totalled 53.81 billion rupees so far against a notified 25.00 billion rupees, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said in a statement, issued on Friday night.
The bonds carrying an annual interest rate of 13.05 percent opened on April 30.
"Some subscriptions received at designated branches of State Bank of India ....at district headquarters of the states are still being reported," the RBI said.
"The subscriptions will be accepted in full," it added.
